purpose: First integrated slice feasibility gate; preserves full NEAR 1 Pgas objective.
slice: Bounded prepared Wasm const/add/drop/end execution with entry/exit and gas; no-host restriction explicit.

requirements.name: Accepted proof implies actual execution
requirements.needed: Derive AIR validity, row/code provenance, entry boundary, gas and final state from the verifier and bound public inputs; not supplied per-row certificates.

requirements.name: Same committed data throughout
requirements.needed: Bind code/public state, AIR sources, GKR statements and final PCS claims; no separately trusted original proofs or unbound witness data.

requirements.name: Complete soundness ledger
requirements.needed: Close all algebraic/commitment/transcript reductions. Quantify the 128-bit quantum resource target and compiler constants; interactive tails alone do not pass.

requirements.name: Complete bytes and scaling
requirements.needed: Measure all required proof inputs for the actual compiled slice and a degree growth sweep. Sub300000-byte toy PCS alone does not pass.

requirements.name: Adversarial validation
requirements.needed: Fresh verifier plus coherent wrong state/code/gas/memory/claim and cross-layer substitution cases; existing PCS mutation checks are only component evidence.

priority: Finish current candidate-list checkpoint, then integration and soundness/size feasibility review before adding instruction families.
not_success: Separate successful AIR and PCS runs
Conditional unproved Johnson/MCA or quantum compiler premises
A tiny proof at a degree where disclosing coefficients is cheaper
